description: Log-match alert policies for the deployed services (scripts/gcp/setup_alerts.sh, docs/wiki/observability.md). Each quoted phrase in a filter is a message the app logs; tests/test_alert_policies.py keeps them in the code.

policies.documentation: The app could not reach Supabase and answers from the local search, counts questions in memory, or keeps visit-prep runs in memory (docs/adr/0007, docs/wiki/cloud-run.md). Check the Supabase project status; a canary drill with fault=supabase also triggers this.
policies.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=("ragdog-api" OR "ragdog") AND ("Supabase search failed" OR "rate limit table unavailable" OR "visit-prep store unavailable")

policies.documentation: The OpenAI project is out of quota: chat shows search results without an answer and visit-prep is paused (docs/adr/0011-degrade-on-model-quota.md). Raise the limit or add credit.
A chat answer or a visit-prep report failed with an error (api/chat.py, api/visit_prep.py). Open the log entry for the exception and the Langfuse trace of that time.
policies.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="ragdog-api" AND ("chat failed" OR "visit-prep run failed")
